placements.title: A statement or frame is read rightly only inside the context that gives it direction
placements.frame: Does this expression keep the narrative, call or position context that tells a reader which direction it supports, or has it been lifted out and made to carry meaning alone?
placements.why: The unit-of-expand position and the frame-versus-statements position make the same claim. A single position or frame alone loses what it means, so expands return the whole call or narrative and judges see a position whole. The theme will keep accruing as read and cite passes are examined.

placements.title: Recall is confirmed against a judged reference, never assumed or copied from production
placements.frame: What reference is this recall or precision claim measured against, and what confirms that the pool was exhaustive and the small-model judgments are right?
placements.why: The position rejects replicating production as the target. It sets up a judged oracle with big-model arms, small-model overlays, her review and a complement pass, and it presses on what the remaining gap to full recall is. The measured recoveries are evidence inside that position, so the leaf stays a subject and not a fact.

placements.title: Build only what is novel and stand on mature components for everything else
placements.frame: What is genuinely new in this piece of work, and if it is not, why is it not taking an existing engine or primitive instead?
placements.why: The position separates novel steering from recall and precision, concedes the hand-rolled read layer was the weak link, and sets a shoulders-of-giants standing rule. It records the ruled consequences and the extend-first rule. The theme will recur whenever a session proposes to roll its own.

placements.title: A limit exists to catch runaway behavior, and everyday shaping belongs in the prompt
placements.frame: Is this limit a circuit breaker set far above normal use, or is it being used to shape ordinary output that the prompt should ask for?
placements.why: The position states the circuit-breaker view of output caps, writes it into the llm-calls rules file, and sets beside it the model that ran away uncapped. The principle of a guardrail sized for failure applies beyond caps and will accrue support.

placements.title: Design fully and test before anything is exported or implemented elsewhere
placements.frame: Has this design been fully worked and tested in the session that owns it, before other sessions or surfaces are asked to build on it?
placements.why: The position holds the sequencing rule: nothing is exported as a build input until tested, the earlier ruling had been passed on prematurely, and the prompt rewrite is parked until the design is solid. It is a standing process stance that future sessions will keep feeding.
